        selection_history="Exact20 RAW boundaryBODY C9102 passed return/annualDD/negativeyears but109closed failed110frequency; exact55 localBODYrecovery C7980 had118closed but2023-0.0252056%. Combining complementary route information is a structural hypothesis after observed outcomes, not arithmetic compensation or cutoff tuning.     print({"geometry": "PUBLISHED", "dimensions": 13, "points": 32, "centers_if_qualified": 3})


if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Three exact-coordinate original/coupled/RAW-BELOW-reentry complete-account contrasts."""

from statistics import mean
from common import RUNS, read, write
from run_parameters import source_check


def pair_analysis(analysis):
    if analysis["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return {"status": "NOT_APPLICABLE", "reason": analysis["reason"], "comparisons": {}}
    assert analysis["status"] == "PASS" and set(analysis["points"]) == {
        "B0-TIME",
        "B0-COUPLED",
        "N0",
    }
    assert set(analysis["summaries"]) == {"B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED", "N0"}
    assert analysis["summaries"]["N0"]["center_qualified"]
    comparisons = {
        "N0": contrast(
            analysis,
            "B0-TIME",
            "N0",
            "RAW BELOW bear-BODY recovery plus bull-boundary-BODY local ACF eligibility recovery OR exception versus original RAW eligibility; identical13 numeric coordinates, original raw statistic/confirmation/bull/holding/H unchanged; originalACFpass bear entries have no BODY veto; bull boundary BODY guard is explicit, range/momentum/score still required; full-account propagated effect, not deletion of old trade PnL",
        ),
        "N0-vs-B0-COUPLED": contrast(
            analysis,
            "B0-COUPLED",
            "N0",
            "New RAW local ACF recovery OR eligibility versus old MEAN BELOW CLOSE AND direction reentry; old centered ACF and current CLOSE-up veto differ from new rawACFpass OR selected bear-BODY recovery plus bull-boundary-BODY recovery. Same numeric coordinates; multi-structure historical contrast, not isolated direction-gate evidence",
        ),
        "B0-COUPLED": contrast(
            analysis,
            "B0-TIME",
            "B0-COUPLED",
            "Exact old native controls, no new evaluation; existing coupled versus original contrast",
        ),
    }
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "comparisons": comparisons,
        "scope": "Three complete32 cohorts, original13 common domains/numeric centers/5%L2/seed13 coordinates. Native reused identities/bindings preserved. RAW local eligibility OR recovery and old MEAN AND direction gate differ structurally; common coordinates do not certify structural robustness. Diagnostic-only prior RAW BODY-only ACF recovery C7980 excluded from this panel and qualification vetoes.",
        "eligibility": "Only original-four-gate-qualified newN0 receives32 new complete accounts. Both controls strictly reused; all point gates diagnostic, no additional economic veto.",
    }


def contrast(analysis, reference, label, purpose):
    assert reference in analysis["points"], (label, reference)
    old = sorted(analysis["points"][reference], key=lambda row: row["point_index"])
    new = sorted(analysis["points"][label], key=lambda row: row["point_index"])
    assert len(old) == len(new) == 32
    assert (
        [row["point_index"] for row in old]
        == [row["point_index"] for row in new]
        == list(range(32))
    )
    rows = []
    for first, second in zip(old, new, strict=True):
        assert (
            first["coordinates"] == second["coordinates"]
            and first["point_index"] == second["point_index"]
        )
        assert first["actual_radius"] == second["actual_radius"]
        rows.append(
            {
                "point_index": first["point_index"],
                "cagr_difference": second["net_cagr"] - first["net_cagr"],
                "drawdown_difference": second["drawdown"] - first["drawdown"],
                "y2022_difference": second["annual"]["2022"]["return"]
                - first["annual"]["2022"]["return"],
                "y2023_difference": second["annual"]["2023"]["return"]
                - first["annual"]["2023"]["return"],
                "closed_difference": second["closed_trades"] - first["closed_trades"],
                "original_qualified": first["qualified"],
                "new_qualified": second["qualified"],
            }
        )
    first, second = analysis["summaries"][reference], analysis["summaries"][label]
    result = {
        "control": reference,
        "new_center": label,
        "purpose": purpose,
        "control_role": first["role"],
        "control_center_qualified": first["center_qualified"],
        "new_center_qualified": second["center_qualified"],
        "complete_pairs": 32,
        "pairs": rows,
        "cagr_better_points": sum(row["cagr_difference"] > 0 for row in rows),
        "cagr_worse_points": sum(row["cagr_difference"] < 0 for row in rows),
        "cagr_same_points": sum(row["cagr_difference"] == 0 for row in rows),
        "drawdown_better_points": sum(row["drawdown_difference"] < 0 for row in rows),
        "drawdown_worse_points": sum(row["drawdown_difference"] > 0 for row in rows),
        "drawdown_same_points": sum(row["drawdown_difference"] == 0 for row in rows),
        "mean_cagr_difference": mean(row["cagr_difference"] for row in rows),
        "mean_drawdown_difference": mean(row["drawdown_difference"] for row in rows),
        "q10_cagr_difference": second["q10_cagr"] - first["q10_cagr"],
        "q90_drawdown_difference": second["q90_drawdown"] - first["q90_drawdown"],
        "return_degradation_difference": second["return_degradation"] - first["return_degradation"],
        "drawdown_degradation_difference": second["drawdown_degradation"]
        - first["drawdown_degradation"],
    }
    return result


def main():
    source_check()
    output = pair_analysis(read(RUNS / "parameter_analysis.json"))
    write(RUNS / "parameter_pairs.json", output)
    print({"paired_centers": list(output["comparisons"]), "status": output["status"]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Public SE complete parameter diagnostics and unchanged four-gate reporting."""

# ruff: noqa: E402
import os

for variable in (
    "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS",
    "OMP_NUM_THREADS",
    "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
    "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS",
):
    os.environ[variable] = "1"

from collections import Counter
import importlib.util
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_evaluator import (
    CandidateAssessmentRequest,
    ParameterRobustnessComparisonRequest,
    PerturbationLink,
    QuantileMethod,
    ResearchMetric,
    SelfCheckProtocol,
    assess_candidates,
    compare_parameter_robustness,
)
from strategy_runtime import canonical_sha256
from czsc_trader.research_tools import build_assessment_evidence
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evaluation import (
    serialize_evaluation_evidence,
    validate_evaluation_evidence,
)
from account_reference import verify_account
from analysis_reference import annual
from boundary_recovery_oracle import audit_boundary_recovery
from common import PROTOCOLS, ROOT, RUNS, cache_read, context, file_hash, read, write
from run_parameters import (
    CONTROLS,
    MANIFEST,
    TRANSPORT,
    point_cache,
    publish_material,
    source_check,
)


def load_legacy_oracle():
    legacy = read(PROTOCOLS / "geometry.json")["legacy_direction_oracle"]
    assert legacy["path"] == "research/S013/experiments/EX043_20261011/src/direction_oracle.py"
    path = ROOT / legacy["path"]
    assert file_hash(path) == legacy["sha256"]
    name = "_s013_ex058_frozen_ex043_direction_oracle"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.audit_direction


def audit_signal_path(key, ctx, bound, frame, parameters):
    if key == "N0":
        assert parameters["mechanism"] == "RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY"
        return audit_boundary_recovery(ctx, bound, frame, parameters)
    if key == "B0-COUPLED":
        assert parameters["mechanism"] == "MEAN_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_CLOSE"
        return load_legacy_oracle()(ctx, bound, frame, parameters)
    assert key == "B0-TIME" and "mechanism" not in parameters
    return None


def economic(bound, result):
    run = result.runs[0]
    own, benchmark = run.execution.account_daily, run.buyhold.account_daily
    years, byears = annual(own), annual(benchmark)
    cagr = float((own.equity.iloc[-1] / 1_000_000) ** (252 / len(own)) - 1)
    bcagr = float((benchmark.equity.iloc[-1] / 1_000_000) ** (252 / len(benchmark)) - 1)
    wealth = np.r_[1_000_000, own.equity.to_numpy()]
    drawdown = float(np.max(1 - wealth / np.maximum.accumulate(wealth)))
    closed = int(run.execution.trades.status.eq("CLOSED").sum())
    negative = [year for year in byears if byears[year]["return"] < 0]
    gates = {
        "return": cagr >= 1.5 * bcagr if bcagr > 0 else cagr > 0,
        "annual_drawdown": all(years[y]["drawdown"] < byears[y]["drawdown"] for y in years),
        "frequency": closed * 60 / len(own) >= 4,
        "negative_buyhold_year_profit": all(years[y]["return"] > 0 for y in negative),
    }
    audit = verify_account(bound, result)
    return {
        "net_cagr": cagr,
        "drawdown": drawdown,
        "closed_trades": closed,
        "frequency60": closed * 60 / len(own),
        "annual": years,
        "benchmark_annual": byears,
        "gates": gates,
        "qualified": all(gates.values()),
        "account_audit": audit,
    }


def main():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        write(
            RUNS / "parameter_analysis.json",
            {
                "status": "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "reason": manifest["reason"],
                "new_parameter_business_accounts": 0,
                "reused_parameter_accounts": 0,
                "actual_parameter_evaluations": 0,
                "technical_duplicate_evaluations": 0,
                "unqualified_control_keys": [],
                "qualified_flags": manifest["qualified_flags"],
            },
        )
        return
    matrix = read(RUNS / "parameter_matrix.json")
    assert matrix["status"] == "COMPLETE"
    assert len(matrix["rows"]) == len(manifest["centers"]) * 32
    prepared = cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz")
    evidence, links, designs, point_rows, central = [], [], [], {}, {}
    benchmark = prepared[0]["result"].runs[0].buyhold.execution

    def same_benchmark(result):
        for name in ("decisions", "orders", "fills", "account_daily", "trades"):
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
                getattr(benchmark, name),
                getattr(result.runs[0].buyhold.execution, name),
                check_exact=True,
            )

    for record, transport in zip(manifest["centers"], prepared, strict=True):
        assert record["control_key"] == transport["control_key"]
        same_benchmark(transport["result"])
        plan = transport["plan"]
        center = plan.design.center
        center_facts = build_assessment_evidence(transport["center"], transport["result"])
        assert center_facts[0].candidate == center
        evidence.extend(center_facts)
        designs.append(plan.design)
        central[record["control_key"]] = economic(transport["center"], transport["result"])
        center_audit = audit_signal_path(
            record["control_key"],
            context(1),
            transport["center"],
            transport["result"].runs[0].execution.decisions,
            transport["center"].strategy.payload["parameters"],
        )
        central[record["control_key"]]["signal_path_audit"] = center_audit
        assert central[record["control_key"]]["qualified"] == record["center_qualified"]
        point_rows[record["control_key"]] = []
        rows = [row for row in matrix["rows"] if row["control_key"] == record["control_key"]]
        assert sorted(row["point_index"] for row in rows) == list(range(32))
        for row in rows:
            bound, result = cache_read(point_cache(record["control_key"], row["label"]))
            ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(row["reference"])
            assert file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
            formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
            validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
            assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
            same_benchmark(result)
            facts = build_assessment_evidence(bound, result)
            assert len(facts) == 1
            evidence.extend(facts)
            binding = bound.lineage.parameter_binding.point
            assert binding == plan.design.bind_point(row["point_index"])
            links.append(
                PerturbationLink(
                    center,
                    facts[0].candidate,
                    1.0,
                    canonical_sha256(bound.lineage.derivation.to_dict()),
                    binding,
                )
            )
            signal_audit = audit_signal_path(
                record["control_key"],
                context(1),
                bound,
                result.runs[0].execution.decisions,
                bound.strategy.payload["parameters"],
            )
            point_rows[record["control_key"]].append(
                {
                    **row,
                    **economic(bound, result),
                    "signal_path_audit": signal_audit,
                    "coordinates": list(binding.coordinates),
                    "actual_radius": binding.actual_radius,
                }
            )
    protocol = SelfCheckProtocol(
        "S013-EX058-common-domain-parameter-diagnostic-v1",
        "full",
        "baseline",
        "not_run_stress",
        126,
        21,
        QuantileMethod.LINEAR,
        32,
        20,
        2000,
        20,
        13,
        1e-6,
        10,
        designs[0].protocol,
    )
    request = CandidateAssessmentRequest(
        tuple(x.center for x in designs),
        protocol,
        tuple(links),
        tuple(evidence),
        parameter_designs=tuple(designs),
    )
    panel = assess_candidates(request)
    comparison = compare_parameter_robustness(ParameterRobustnessComparisonRequest(panel.rows))
    assert comparison.comparable, comparison.to_dict()
    summaries = {}
    for record, row in zip(manifest["centers"], panel.rows, strict=True):
        label = record["control_key"]
        values = {x.metric: x for x in row.diagnostics}
        return_metric = values[ResearchMetric.PARAMETER_RETURN_DEGRADATION]
        dd_metric = values[ResearchMetric.PARAMETER_DRAWDOWN_DEGRADATION]
        assert return_metric.status.value == dd_metric.status.value == "AVAILABLE"
        points = point_rows[label]
        q10 = float(np.quantile([x["net_cagr"] for x in points], 0.1, method="linear"))
        q90 = float(np.quantile([x["drawdown"] for x in points], 0.9, method="linear"))
        assert abs(return_metric.value - max(0.0, central[label]["net_cagr"] - q10)) < 1e-12
        assert abs(dd_metric.value - max(0.0, q90 - central[label]["drawdown"])) < 1e-12
        summaries[label] = {
            "candidate_id": record["candidate_id"],
            "mechanism": record["mechanism"],
            "background": record["background"],
            "center": central[label],
            "complete_points": len(points),
            "role": record["role"],
            "center_qualified": record["center_qualified"],
            "implementation_parent": record.get("implementation_parent"),
            "time_semantics": record.get("time_semantics", "Original held-session TIME"),
            "entry_eligibility_structure": record.get("entry_eligibility_structure"),
            "bear_acf_structure": record.get("bear_acf_structure"),
            "baseline_semantics": record.get("baseline_semantics"),
            "source_sha256": record.get("source_sha256"),
            "q10_cagr": q10,
            "q90_drawdown": q90,
            "return_degradation": return_metric.value,
            "drawdown_degradation": dd_metric.value,
            "qualified_points": sum(x["qualified"] for x in points),
            "failed_gate_counts": dict(
                Counter(name for x in points for name, passed in x["gates"].items() if not passed)
            ),
            "known_low_error_potential_orders": sum(
                x["account_audit"]["known_low_error_potential_orders"] for x in points
            ),
            "parameter_context": row.parameter_context.to_dict(),
        }
    original = summaries["B0-TIME"]
    differences = {
        label: {
            "center_cagr_difference": row["center"]["net_cagr"] - original["center"]["net_cagr"],
            "center_drawdown_difference": row["center"]["drawdown"]
            - original["center"]["drawdown"],
            "return_degradation_difference": row["return_degradation"]
            - original["return_degradation"],
            "drawdown_degradation_difference": row["drawdown_degradation"]
            - original["drawdown_degradation"],
            "q10_cagr_difference": row["q10_cagr"] - original["q10_cagr"],
            "q90_drawdown_difference": row["q90_drawdown"] - original["q90_drawdown"],
        }
        for label, row in summaries.items()
        if label != "B0-TIME"
    }
    coupled = summaries["B0-COUPLED"]
    differences_from_coupled = {
        key: summaries["N0"][key] - coupled[key]
        for key in ("q10_cagr", "q90_drawdown", "return_degradation", "drawdown_degradation")
    }
    output = {
        "status": "PASS",
        "summaries": summaries,
        "differences_from_original": differences,
        "differences_from_coupled": differences_from_coupled,
        "points": point_rows,
        "se_comparison": comparison.to_dict(),
        "diagnostic_boundary": "Four original gates remain diagnostic on neighbors; no additional eligibility veto.",
        "scope": "Three parameter cohorts at all13 original full domains/numeric centers/5%L2/32 identical coordinates. New RAW eligibility is range AND momentum AND (rawACFpass OR selected flatbear priorbearTIME BELOW BODY-positive recovery and bull-boundary BODY restriction), then original confirmation; originalACFpass bear entries not BODY-vetoed; bull boundary BODY guard is explicit, holding has no exception. Original raw ACF20 statistic/confirmation/bull/H/holding exits unchanged. Oldcoupled centered ACF plus BELOW CLOSE AND gate is a different historical structure. Prior RAW BODY-only ACF recovery C7980 stays one diagnostic-only center outside panel and vetoes. Exposed development pool, not independent validation; no category/window robustness claim.",
        "historical_comparison": manifest["historical_comparison"],
        "execution_reconciliation": "Original EX01532 and coupled EX043N0 32 exact native identities/labels/plans/lineage/bindings/accounts reused; control_key aliases/cache directories preserve native identity. Qualified new32business/33actual only, original C2132 IMPLEMENTATION parent and newcenter PARAMETERS parent. New RAW BELOW oracle only N0; frozen EX043 MEAN BELOW oracle only coupled. Original rawACF20/ranges/score/H/exit rules remain exact; new warmup max(parent,regimeW+2) retains full domains (center/same32 unchanged,61-to62 full-domain corner). Current signalClose/Open, complete daily previousClose and final bearTIME anchor category are causal; previous full-daily raw route is explicitly required; no fill/future information. No new evaluation or parameter panel for diagnostic-only RAW BODY recovery C7980 or bull-boundary BODY C9102.",
        "new_parameter_business_accounts": manifest["new_parameter_business_accounts"],
        "reused_parameter_accounts": manifest["reused_parameter_accounts"],
        "comparison_basis_from_original": "All13 numeric centers/domains/32 coordinates identical. Old-path cash contributions, including2023 BELOW +2.3049pp, cannot be removed/summed as mechanism gain; all years retained.",
        "center_eligibility": "Original four economic goals only; parameter diagnostics do not add a veto or promote unqualified controls.",
        "unqualified_control_keys": manifest["unqualified_control_keys"],
        "qualified_flags": manifest["qualified_flags"],
        "technical_duplicate_evaluations": 1,
        "evaluation_count_basis": manifest["evaluation_count_basis"],
        "actual_parameter_evaluations": matrix["actual_run_evaluations"]
        + read(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json")["actual_evaluations"],
    }
    assert set(summaries) == {*CONTROLS, "N0"}
    assert set(summaries) == {"B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED", "N0"}
    assert all(summaries[label]["center_qualified"] for label in summaries if label != "B0-TIME")
    assert output["reused_parameter_accounts"] == 64
    assert output["new_parameter_business_accounts"] == 32
    assert output["actual_parameter_evaluations"] == 33
    write(RUNS / "parameter_analysis.json", output)
    ctx = context(1)
    refs = {
        "request": publish_material(
            ctx, "parameter-se-assessment-request", request.to_dict()
        ).to_dict(),
        "panel": publish_material(ctx, "parameter-se-assessment-panel", panel.to_dict()).to_dict(),
        "analysis": publish_material(ctx, "parameter-complete-analysis", output).to_dict(),
    }
    write(PROTOCOLS / "parameter_analysis_references.json", refs)
    print(
        {
            "parameter_analysis": "PASS",
            "summaries": {
                label: {
                    key: row[key]
                    for key in (
                        "q10_cagr",
                        "q90_drawdown",
                        "return_degradation",
                        "drawdown_degradation",
                        "qualified_points",
                    )
                }
                for label, row in summaries.items()
            },
        },
        flush=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""EX058 prospective public three-center parameter comparison with exact native control reuse."""

# ruff: noqa: E402
import os

for variable in (
    "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS",
    "OMP_NUM_THREADS",
    "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
    "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS",
):
    os.environ[variable] = "1"
import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import replace
import json
import time
import optuna
import pandas as pd
from strategy_evaluator import (
    AssessmentCandidate,
    ParameterCoordinate,
    ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest,
    ParameterPerturbationProtocol,
    ParameterSpace,
    build_parameter_perturbation_design,
)
from strategy_manager import (
    CandidateDerivation,
    CandidateDerivationKind,
    CandidateEvidence,
    CandidateKey,
)
from strategy_runtime import StrategyCandidate, canonical_sha256
from czsc_trader.application import publish_evidence, publish_evidence_many
from czsc_trader.research_tools import (
    EvaluationEvidenceWrite,
    EvaluationLineage,
    MaterialEvidenceWrite,
    ParameterEvaluationPlan,
)
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evaluation import (
    serialize_evaluation_evidence,
    validate_evaluation_evidence,
)
from common import (
    CACHE,
    EXPERIMENT,
    PROTOCOLS,
    ROOT,
    RUNS,
    SOURCE_CALLS,
    SRC,
    cache_read,
    cache_write,
    context,
    file_hash,
    read,
    write,
)

TRANSPORT = CACHE / "parameters"
MANIFEST = PROTOCOLS / "parameter_plans.json"
CHECKPOINT = RUNS / "parameter_matrix.json"
CONTROLS = ("B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED")
MECHANISM = "RAW_BULL_BOUNDARY_BODY_BEAR_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY"
RESERVED_FIRST = 8840
RESERVED_LAST = 8871


def plain(value):
    return json.loads(json.dumps(value, default=dict, allow_nan=False))


def publish_material(ctx, name, value):
    return publish_evidence(
        ctx,
        MaterialEvidenceWrite(
            EXPERIMENT,
            name,
            (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode(),
            "application/json",
            "json",
        ),
    )


def get_path(parameters, name):
    target = parameters
    for part in name.split("."):
        target = target[part]
    return target


def materialize(parameters, geometry, values):
    parameters = deepcopy(parameters)
    for (name, _, _, kind), value in zip(geometry["coordinates"], values, strict=True):
        parts = name.split(".")
        target = parameters
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            target = target[part]
        target[parts[-1]] = int(value) if kind == "INTEGER" else float(value)
    return parameters


def feasible(coordinates):
    # Exact order is authenticated by the already published geometry.
    return bool(coordinates[1] < coordinates[2] and coordinates[5] < coordinates[6])


def equal_results(serial, spawned):
    assert serial.result_hash == spawned.result_hash
    for left, right in zip(serial.runs, spawned.runs, strict=True):
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
            left.signals.decisions, right.signals.decisions, check_exact=True
        )
        for a, b in (
            (left.execution, right.execution),
            (left.buyhold.execution, right.buyhold.execution),
        ):
            for field in ("decisions", "orders", "fills", "account_daily", "trades"):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
                    getattr(a, field), getattr(b, field), check_exact=True
                )


def source_check():
    experiment = read(PROTOCOLS / "plan.json")
    reference = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read(PROTOCOLS / "plan_reference.json"))
    assert (
        reference.experiment == EXPERIMENT
        and file_hash(reference.resolve(ROOT)) == reference.sha256
    )
    assert read(reference.resolve(ROOT)) == experiment
    for relative, digest in experiment["source_files"].items():
        assert file_hash(SRC / relative) == digest
    geometry = read(PROTOCOLS / "geometry.json")
    reference = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read(PROTOCOLS / "geometry_reference.json"))
    assert (
        reference.experiment == EXPERIMENT
        and file_hash(reference.resolve(ROOT)) == reference.sha256
    )
    assert read(reference.resolve(ROOT)) == geometry
    required = {
        "run_parameters.py",
        "parameter_analysis.py",
        "pair_parameters.py",
        "declare_geometry.py",
        "common.py",
        "account_reference.py",
        "ledger_reference.py",
        "analysis_reference.py",
    }
    assert set(geometry["helper_source_files"]) == required
    for relative, digest in geometry["helper_source_files"].items():
        path = (SRC / relative).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(SRC.resolve()) and file_hash(path) == digest
    assert file_hash(SRC / "boundary_recovery_oracle.py") == geometry["boundary_recovery_oracle_sha256"]
    legacy = geometry["legacy_direction_oracle"]
    assert legacy["path"] == "research/S013/experiments/EX043_20261011/src/direction_oracle.py"
    assert file_hash(ROOT / legacy["path"]) == legacy["sha256"]
    assert geometry["candidate_reservation"] == {"first": RESERVED_FIRST, "last": RESERVED_LAST}
    return experiment, geometry


def resolve_center(config, experiment_id=EXPERIMENT.experiment_id, seen=None):
    seen = set() if seen is None else seen
    key = (experiment_id, config["label"])
    assert key not in seen, "Cyclic native reuse chain"
    seen.add(key)
    if config.get("reused"):
        origin, label = config["reuse_from"], config["reuse_label"]
        assert origin.startswith(("EX012_", "EX013_", "EX014_", "EX015_", "EX043_"))
        path = ROOT / ".tmp" / ("s013-mechanism-" + origin[:5]) / (label + ".pkl.gz")
        if path.exists():
            return cache_read(path)
        previous = read(ROOT / "research/S013/experiments" / origin / "protocols/plan.json")
        parent = next(
            row
            for row in previous.get("controls", []) + previous["configurations"]
            if row.get("label", row.get("background", "") + "-" + row.get("mode", "")) == label
        )
        assert (
            parent["candidate_id"] == config["candidate_id"]
            and parent["payload"] == config["payload"]
        )
        assert parent["content_sha256"] == config["content_sha256"]
        return resolve_center(parent, origin, seen)
    return cache_read(
        ROOT / ".tmp" / ("s013-mechanism-" + experiment_id[:5]) / (config["label"] + ".pkl.gz")
    )


def point_cache(control_key, native_label):
    assert control_key in (*CONTROLS, "N0")
    assert (
        native_label.startswith(("B0-TIME-P", "N0-P"))
        and "/" not in native_label
        and "\\" not in native_label
    )
    return TRANSPORT / control_key / (native_label + ".pkl.gz")


def select_new_centers(experiment, analysis):
    assert [row["label"] for row in experiment["controls"]] == list(CONTROLS)
    assert [row["label"] for row in experiment["configurations"]] == ["N0"]
    config = experiment["configurations"][0]
    assert config["mechanism"] == MECHANISM and config["parent_control"] == "B0-TIME"
    return [config] if analysis["rows"]["N0"]["qualified"] else []


def authenticate_center(ctx, config, reference, bound, result):
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(reference)
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
    validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
    assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
    assert (
        plain(bound.strategy.payload) == config["payload"]
        and bound.strategy.candidate_id == config["candidate_id"]
    )
    identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
    assert identity.content_sha256 == config["content_sha256"]
    assert identity.source_sha256 == config["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
    assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
    return ref, identity


def prepare_required(ctx, request, label):
    try:
        return ctx.evaluation.prepare(request)
    except Exception as error:
        write(
            RUNS / "parameter_preparation_failure.json",
            {
                "status": "FAILED",
                "label": label,
                "error_type": type(error).__name__,
                "message": str(error),
                "provider_calls": list(SOURCE_CALLS),
                "policy": "Existing prepared S013 assets only; original raw ACF20/score/range/rawregime requirements and parent warmup exactly unchanged. Body uses current signalClose/Open, previous complete daily rawregime uses shift1 before reindex; max(parent,regimeW+2) is required. All full13 domains retained; existing prepared history shortage FAILED. No fill, fallback, download, point replacement or automatic retry.",
            },
        )
        raise


def implementation_parent(ctx, experiment, refs, config):
    parent = next(row for row in experiment["controls"] if row["label"] == "B0-TIME")
    bound, result = resolve_center(parent)
    reference, identity = authenticate_center(ctx, parent, refs["B0-TIME"], bound, result)
    assert parent["candidate_id"] == "C2132"
    assert (
        ROOT / "research/registrations/S013/candidates" / (parent["candidate_id"] + ".json")
    ).is_file()
    old, new = deepcopy(parent["payload"]["parameters"]), deepcopy(config["payload"]["parameters"])
    assert "mechanism" not in old and new.pop("mechanism") == MECHANISM
    assert old == new, (
        "Original range/momentum eligibility is locally expanded only for ACF-failing BELOW bear TIME context with strict BODY-up plus bullboundary BODY restriction; no extra veto of original ACF-passing bear opportunities; original raw ACF and all13 numeric centers unchanged"
    )
    return {
        "control_key": "B0-TIME",
        "candidate_id": parent["candidate_id"],
        "content_sha256": identity.content_sha256,
        "source_sha256": identity.source_sha256,
        "reference": reference.to_dict(),
        "kind": "IMPLEMENTATION",
        "scope": "Registered original C2132 is IMPLEMENTATION parent. Original raw ACF20 statistic/confirmation and all13 numerical centers remain. Eligibility is range AND momentum AND (original rawACFpass OR selected flatrawbear priorfinalbearTIME BELOW BODY-up plus bullboundary BODY restriction recovery); originalACFpass bear entries have no BODY veto; bull boundary BODY guard is explicit, recovery includes no new score condition; original threshold remains unchanged, original confirmation still required, holding has no exception. Context persists flat/rawroute changes and is consumed by any signalentry; all original holding exits/H remain.",
    }


def reuse_parameter_control(ctx, key, config, center_reference, design):
    origin, native_label, matrix_name = (
        ("EX015_20261011", "B0-TIME", "parameter_matrix.json")
        if key == "B0-TIME"
        else ("EX043_20261011", "N0", "parameter_matrix_v3.json")
    )
    base = ROOT / "research/S013"
    previous = read(base / "experiments" / origin / "protocols/parameter_plans.json")
    record = next(row for row in previous["centers"] if row["label"] == native_label)
    cache = ROOT / ".tmp" / ("s013-mechanism-" + origin[:5]) / "parameters"
    transport = next(
        row for row in cache_read(cache / "prepared.pkl.gz") if row["label"] == native_label
    )
    old_design = transport["plan"].design
    assert old_design.center == design.center and old_design.protocol == design.protocol
    assert (
        old_design.space.coordinates == design.space.coordinates
        and old_design.points == design.points
    )
    assert record["center_reference"] == center_reference
    matrix = read(base / "assets/runs" / origin / matrix_name)
    assert matrix["status"] == "COMPLETE"
    native_rows = sorted(
        (row for row in matrix["rows"] if row["center"] == native_label),
        key=lambda row: row["point_index"],
    )
    assert [row["point_index"] for row in native_rows] == list(range(32))
    rows = []
    for row in native_rows:
        bound, result = cache_read(cache / (row["label"] + ".pkl.gz"))
        ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(row["reference"])
        assert file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
        formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
        validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
        assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
        assert (
            bound.strategy.candidate_id == row["candidate_id"]
            and result.request_hash == row["request_hash"]
        )
        assert (
            result.result_hash == row["result_hash"]
            and bound.dependencies == transport["center"].dependencies
        )
        binding = bound.lineage.parameter_binding
        assert binding.point == old_design.bind_point(row["point_index"])
        assert binding.plan.to_dict() == record["plan_reference"]
        assert file_hash(binding.plan.resolve(ROOT)) == binding.plan.sha256
        assert read(binding.plan.resolve(ROOT)) == transport["plan"].to_dict()
        identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
        assert identity.content_sha256 == row["content_sha256"]
        assert identity.source_sha256 == config["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
        assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
        assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
        cache_write(point_cache(key, row["label"]), (bound, result))
        rows.append(
            {
                **deepcopy(row),
                "control_key": key,
                "reused": True,
                "reused_from": origin,
                "actual_this_experiment": False,
            }
        )
    return (
        {
            **deepcopy(record),
            "control_key": key,
            "native_label": native_label,
            "reused": True,
            "reused_from": origin,
            "center_qualified": True,
            "role": "exact native "
            + key
            + " full32 control; original IDs/labels/plans/lineage preserved",
        },
        {**transport, "control_key": key},
        rows,
    )


def declare(first_candidate=RESERVED_FIRST):
    assert not MANIFEST.exists() and not (RUNS / "parameter_preparation_failure.json").exists()
    experiment, geometry = source_check()
    analysis = read(RUNS / "analysis.json")
    assert analysis["status"] == "PASS"
    selected = select_new_centers(experiment, analysis)
    flags = {label: row["qualified"] for label, row in analysis["rows"].items()}
    if not selected:
        output = {
            "status": "NOT_APPLICABLE",
            "reason": "NO_NEW_FOUR_GATE_QUALIFIED_CONFIGURATION",
            "new_parameter_business_accounts": 0,
            "reused_parameter_accounts": 0,
            "actual_parameter_evaluations": 0,
            "planned_actual_parameter_evaluations": 0,
            "technical_duplicate_evaluations": 0,
            "unqualified_control_keys": [],
            "qualified_flags": flags,
        }
        output["reference"] = publish_material(
            context(1), "parameter-not-applicable", output
        ).to_dict()
        write(MANIFEST, output)
        return
    assert (
        type(first_candidate) is int
        and first_candidate == RESERVED_FIRST
        and type(RESERVED_LAST) is int
    )
    assert all(analysis["rows"][key]["qualified"] for key in CONTROLS)
    ctx = context(8)
    geometry_ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read(PROTOCOLS / "geometry_reference.json"))
    mapping = publish_material(
        ctx,
        "parameter-coordinate-mapping",
        {
            "geometry": geometry_ref.to_dict(),
            "coordinates": geometry["coordinates"],
            "mapping": geometry["mapping"],
        },
    )
    feasibility = publish_material(
        ctx,
        "parameter-coordinate-feasibility",
        {
            "geometry": geometry_ref.to_dict(),
            "predicate": geometry["feasibility"],
            "no_outcome_filter": True,
        },
    )
    protocol = ParameterPerturbationProtocol(**geometry["protocol"])
    refs = read(RUNS / "account_references.json")
    records, prepared, reused_rows, identities = [], [], [], set()
    matched = None
    number = first_candidate
    for config in [*experiment["controls"], *selected]:
        key = config["label"]
        center, result = resolve_center(config)
        center_ref, identity = authenticate_center(ctx, config, refs[key], center, result)
        parameters = plain(center.strategy.payload["parameters"])
        space = ParameterSpace(
            tuple(
                ParameterCoordinate(
                    name,
                    float(get_path(parameters, name)),
                    low,
                    high,
                    ParameterCoordinateKind(kind),
                )
                for name, low, high, kind in geometry["coordinates"]
            ),
            mapping.sha256,
            feasibility.sha256,
        )
        design_result = build_parameter_perturbation_design(
            ParameterDesignRequest(
                AssessmentCandidate(center.strategy.reference_id, identity.content_sha256),
                protocol,
                space,
            ),
            feasibility=feasible,
        )
        assert design_result.status.value == "COMPLETE", design_result.to_dict()
        design = design_result.design
        if matched is None:
            matched = design
        assert (
            matched.space.coordinates == design.space.coordinates
            and matched.points == design.points
        )
        if key in CONTROLS:
            record, transport, rows = reuse_parameter_control(
                ctx, key, config, center_ref.to_dict(), design
            )
            records.append(record)
            prepared.append(transport)
            reused_rows.extend(rows)
            identities.update(row["content_sha256"] for row in rows)
            continue
        assert key == "N0" and config["mechanism"] == MECHANISM
        assert center.strategy.source_root.resolve() == (SRC / config["source_directory"]).resolve()
        parent = implementation_parent(ctx, experiment, refs, config)
        children, configs = [], []
        for point in design.points:
            assert number <= RESERVED_LAST
            identifier = f"C{number:04}"
            number += 1
            assert not (ROOT / "research/S013/assets/candidates" / identifier).exists()
            assert not (
                ROOT / "research/registrations/S013/candidates" / (identifier + ".json")
            ).exists()
            payload = plain(center.strategy.payload)
            payload["parameters"] = materialize(parameters, geometry, point.coordinates)
            child = StrategyCandidate("S013", identifier, payload, center.strategy.source_root)
            request = replace(
                center,
                experiment_id=EXPERIMENT.experiment_id,
                strategy=child,
                runtime_binding={**center.runtime_binding, "candidate_id": child.reference_id},
                input_bindings={},
                lineage=None,
            )
            request = prepare_required(ctx, request, f"N0-P{point.index:02}")
            child_identity = ctx.runtime.identify(child, dependencies=request.dependencies)
            assert (
                child_identity.source_sha256 == identity.source_sha256
                and child_identity.content_sha256 not in identities
            )
            identities.add(child_identity.content_sha256)
            children.append(request)
            changes = {
                name: {
                    "before": get_path(parameters, name),
                    "after": get_path(payload["parameters"], name),
                }
                for name, *_ in geometry["coordinates"]
                if get_path(parameters, name) != get_path(payload["parameters"], name)
            }
            configs.append(
                {
                    "label": f"N0-P{point.index:02}",
                    "point_index": point.index,
                    "candidate_id": identifier,
                    "content_sha256": child_identity.content_sha256,
                    "changes": changes,
                }
            )
        plan = ParameterEvaluationPlan.create(
            design,
            center,
            tuple(children),
            mapping_evidence=mapping,
            feasibility_evidence=feasibility,
            dataflows=ctx.data,
        )
        plan_ref = publish_material(ctx, "parameter-plan-n0", plan.to_dict())
        bound = []
        for index, (child, cfg) in enumerate(zip(children, configs, strict=True)):
            derivation = CandidateDerivation(
                CandidateKey("S013", center.strategy.candidate_id),
                identity.content_sha256,
                CandidateKey("S013", child.strategy.candidate_id),
                plan.children[index].candidate.content_sha256,
                CandidateDerivationKind.PARAMETERS,
                cfg["changes"],
                protocol.sha256,
                CandidateEvidence(center_ref.repository_path, center_ref.sha256),
            )
            binding = plan.bind_point(plan_ref, index, repository_root=ROOT)
            bound.append(
                prepare_required(
                    ctx,
                    replace(child, lineage=EvaluationLineage(derivation, binding)),
                    cfg["label"] + "-BOUND",
                )
            )
        records.append(
            {
                "label": "N0",
                "control_key": "N0",
                "native_label": "N0",
                "reused": False,
                "candidate_id": center.strategy.candidate_id,
                "mechanism": MECHANISM,
                "background": config["background"],
                "center_qualified": True,
                "role": "qualified original RAW ACF20 background with BELOW bearTIME BODY-up plus bullboundary BODY restriction local ACF eligibility recovery; original ACF-passing bear entries have no direction veto; bull boundary BODY guard is explicit, confirmation and all holding rules unchanged",
                "implementation_parent": parent,
                "source_sha256": identity.source_sha256,
                "center_reference": center_ref.to_dict(),
                "plan_reference": plan_ref.to_dict(),
                "design": design.to_dict(),
                "children": configs,
                "center_request_sha256": plan.center_request_sha256,
                "entry_eligibility_structure": "Eligibility is range_pass AND momentum_pass AND (original rawACFpass OR flatrawbear priorfinalbearTIME strictBELOW with currentClose>currentSignalOpen; originalACFpass OR local recovery on bear, original bull eligibility AND currentBODYup only on rawbear-to-rawbull boundary). Original rawACFpass bear opportunities retain entry without BODY veto, while the stated bull boundary guard applies; recovery contains no new score condition; original confirmation still applies, holding has no exception, then originalconfirmation must pass.",
                "bear_acf_structure": "Original raw ACF20 statistic, bear.acf_min cutoff/full domain, rawacf1 columns and confirmation unchanged. No centering, smoothing, replacement estimator, unit mapping or domain narrowing.",
                "time_semantics": "Original held-session H unchanged; loss>trailing>range>time>regime, with immediate rawregime exits unchanged.",
                "baseline_semantics": "No ACF baseline. L remains active only in original confirmation score, original raw ACF20 filters bear entry. BELOW category uses current exitClose strictly below own signal-entry anchor, not fill PnL; EQUAL/ABOVE/NONE ungated. Context persists flat/rawroute changes, any entry clears. Parent warmup exact; all13 coordinates active.",
            }
        )
        prepared.append(
            {
                "label": "N0",
                "control_key": "N0",
                "center": center,
                "result": result,
                "children": tuple(bound),
                "plan": plan,
            }
        )
    assert number == RESERVED_LAST + 1 and len(reused_rows) == 64 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    cache_write(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz", tuple(prepared))
    output = {
        "status": "DECLARED",
        "geometry": geometry_ref.to_dict(),
        "centers": records,
        "mapping": mapping.to_dict(),
        "feasibility": feasibility.to_dict(),
        "reused_rows": deepcopy(reused_rows),
        "point_count": 96,
        "new_parameter_business_accounts": 32,
        "reused_parameter_accounts": 64,
        "planned_actual_parameter_evaluations": 33,
        "technical_duplicate_evaluations": 1,
        "qualified_new_centers": ["N0"],
        "unqualified_control_keys": [],
        "qualified_flags": flags,
        "resources": {"max_workers": 8, "native_threads": 1, "seed": 13},
        "evaluation_count_basis": "64 exact old native controls reused without evaluation; new32business/33actual: P00serial+spawn2, remaining31bulk. Control aliases never replace native IDs/labels/lineage.",
        "historical_comparison": "All13 original full domains/numeric centers/5%L2/PCG64seed13/HALF_EVEN/LINEAR32 coordinates identical. New versus original adds a local raw ACF eligibility OR exception only after BELOW bearTIME with BODY-positive recovery and bull-boundary BODY restriction; original rawACFpass opportunities are unrestricted by BODY/bullboundary and range/momentum/score still required. Oldcoupled MEAN BELOW CLOSE applies an AND direction veto and a different ACF statistic. Prior RAW BODY-only ACF recovery C7980 is one diagnostic-only negative center, never parameter cohort or additional veto. Same coordinates do not prove structural robustness.",
        "selection": "Only the new original-four-gate-qualified N0 receives32 new points. Controls are existing native identities only; no promotion/re-registration or new old-account evaluation.",
    }
    output["reference"] = publish_material(ctx, "parameter-plan-manifest", output).to_dict()
    write(MANIFEST, output)


def precheck():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return
    assert not (RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json").exists()
    rows, actual = [], 0
    for record, transport in zip(
        manifest["centers"], cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz"), strict=True
    ):
        key = record["control_key"]
        assert key == transport["control_key"]
        if record["reused"]:
            proof = read(
                ROOT
                / "research/S013/assets/runs"
                / record["reused_from"]
                / "parameter_precheck.json"
            )
            ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(proof["reference"])
            assert proof["status"] == "PASS" and file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
            assert read(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == {
                name: value for name, value in proof.items() if name != "reference"
            }
            native = next(row for row in proof["rows"] if row["center"] == record["native_label"])
            rows.append(
                {
                    **deepcopy(native),
                    "control_key": key,
                    "reused": True,
                    "source_reference": ref.to_dict(),
                }
            )
            continue
        bound = transport["children"][0]
        serial = context(1).evaluation.evaluate(bound)
        cache_write(point_cache(key, "N0-P00"), (bound, serial))
        spawned = context(2).evaluation.evaluate_many((bound,))[0]
        assert spawned.status.value == "SUCCEEDED", spawned.error
        cache_write(TRANSPORT / key / "N0-P00-spawn.pkl.gz", (bound, spawned.result))
        equal_results(serial, spawned.result)
        actual += 2
        rows.append(
            {
                "center": "N0",
                "control_key": key,
                "point": 0,
                "reused": False,
                "result_hash": serial.result_hash,
                "serial_spawn": "EXACT_EQUAL signals and5strategy/benchmarkledgers",
            }
        )
    assert actual == 2 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    proof = {"status": "PASS", "rows": rows, "actual_evaluations": actual, "provider_calls": []}
    proof["reference"] = publish_material(context(1), "parameter-precheck", proof).to_dict()
    write(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json", proof)


def trial_index(global_index, reused_count):
    assert type(global_index) is int and type(reused_count) is int and reused_count == 64
    assert reused_count <= global_index < reused_count + 32
    return global_index - reused_count


def run():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return
    assert read(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json")["status"] == "PASS"
    ctx = context(8)
    prepared = cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz")
    record = next(row for row in manifest["centers"] if row["control_key"] == "N0")
    transport = next(row for row in prepared if row["control_key"] == "N0")
    items = list(zip(record["children"], transport["children"], strict=True))
    assert len(items) == 32
    reused_count = len(manifest["reused_rows"])
    assert reused_count == 64
    study_path = TRANSPORT / "study.pkl.gz"
    if study_path.exists():
        study, state = cache_read(study_path), read(CHECKPOINT)
        assert state["status"] != "FAILED" and state["inflight"] is None
        assert (
            len(state["rows"]) >= reused_count
            and state["rows"][:reused_count] == manifest["reused_rows"]
        )
    else:
        optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)
        study = optuna.create_study(
            direction="maximize",
            sampler=optuna.samplers.RandomSampler(seed=13),
            study_name="S013-EX058-raw-bull-boundary-body-bear-below-body-acf-recovery-fixed-parameter-diagnostic",
        )
        for i in range(32):
            study.enqueue_trial({"point": i})
        for i in range(32):
            trial = study.ask()
            assert trial.suggest_int("point", 0, 31) == i
        state = {
            "status": "PARTIAL",
            "rows": deepcopy(manifest["reused_rows"]),
            "inflight": None,
            "actual_run_evaluations": 0,
            "planned_business_accounts": 96,
            "provider_calls": [],
        }
        cache_write(study_path, study)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    for offset in range(len(state["rows"]) - reused_count, len(items), 8):
        batch = items[offset : offset + 8]
        pending = [
            (cfg, bound) for cfg, bound in batch if not point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]).exists()
        ]
        state["inflight"] = [cfg["label"] for cfg, _ in pending]
        state["actual_run_evaluations"] += len(pending)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
        outcomes = (
            ctx.evaluation.evaluate_many(tuple(bound for _, bound in pending)) if pending else ()
        )
        failures = []
        for (cfg, bound), outcome in zip(pending, outcomes, strict=True):
            if outcome.status.value == "SUCCEEDED":
                cache_write(point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]), (bound, outcome.result))
            else:
                failures.append(
                    {
                        "label": cfg["label"],
                        "status": outcome.status.value,
                        "error": {"code": outcome.error.code, "message": outcome.error.message},
                    }
                )
        if failures:
            state.update(status="FAILED", failures=failures, inflight=None)
            write(CHECKPOINT, state)
            raise RuntimeError("Parameter failures retained; no automatic retry/replacement")
        requests, loaded = [], []
        for cfg, expected in batch:
            bound, result = cache_read(point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]))
            assert bound.lineage == expected.lineage
            assert result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256 == cfg["content_sha256"]
            loaded.append((cfg, bound, result))
            requests.append(
                EvaluationEvidenceWrite(
                    EXPERIMENT, "parameter-account-" + cfg["label"].lower(), bound, result
                )
            )
        published = publish_evidence_many(ctx, tuple(requests))
        assert all(outcome.status.value == "PUBLISHED" for outcome in published)
        for index, ((cfg, bound, result), outcome) in enumerate(
            zip(loaded, published, strict=True), start=offset
        ):
            global_index = reused_count + index
            study.tell(
                trial_index(global_index, reused_count), float(result.runs[0].observation.net_cagr)
            )
            state["rows"].append(
                {
                    "label": cfg["label"],
                    "center": "N0",
                    "control_key": "N0",
                    "point_index": cfg["point_index"],
                    "candidate_id": cfg["candidate_id"],
                    "content_sha256": cfg["content_sha256"],
                    "status": "SUCCEEDED",
                    "reference": outcome.reference.to_dict(),
                    "request_hash": result.request_hash,
                    "result_hash": result.result_hash,
                    "reused": False,
                }
            )
        assert len(manifest["reused_rows"]) == reused_count
        state.update(
            status="COMPLETE" if len(state["rows"]) == 96 else "PARTIAL",
            inflight=None,
            elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started,
            provider_calls=SOURCE_CALLS,
        )
        cache_write(study_path, study)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
        print({"parameter_rows": len(state["rows"]), "status": state["status"]}, flush=True)
    assert (
        state["status"] == "COMPLETE" and state["actual_run_evaluations"] == 31 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    )
    state.update(
        new_parameter_business_accounts=32,
        reused_parameter_accounts=64,
        actual_parameter_evaluations=33,
    )
    state["reference"] = publish_material(ctx, "parameter-complete-matrix", state).to_dict()
    write(CHECKPOINT, state)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=("declare", "precheck", "run"))
    parser.add_argument("--first-candidate", type=int, default=RESERVED_FIRST)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    {"declare": lambda: declare(args.first_candidate), "precheck": precheck, "run": run}[
        args.phase
    ]()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Pure helper tests; all financial/native read, prepare/evaluate/publish are spies."""

from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

import optuna
from strategy_evaluator import (
    AssessmentCandidate,
    ParameterCoordinate,
    ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest,
    ParameterPerturbationProtocol,
    ParameterSpace,
    build_parameter_perturbation_design,
)
from strategy_manager import CandidateKey
from czsc_trader.research_tools import EvaluationLineage, ParameterEvaluationPlan


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = next(parent for parent in HERE.parents if (parent / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())
SOURCE = ROOT / ".tmp/ex058-param-prototype"


def main():
    checks, financial_calls, writes = [], [], {}

    def check(name, condition):
        assert condition, name
        checks.append(name)

    def refuse(name, callback):
        try:
            callback()
        except (AssertionError, ValueError, TypeError):
            checks.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected explicit refusal: " + name)

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        financial_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("Financial account operation or read forbidden")

    common = types.ModuleType("common")
    for name, value in {
        "ROOT": ROOT,
        "SRC": SOURCE,
        "CACHE": HERE / "no-native-cache",
        "PROTOCOLS": HERE / "no-formal-protocols",
        "RUNS": HERE / "no-financial-runs",
        "EXPERIMENT": types.SimpleNamespace(experiment_id="EX058_PROTOTYPE"),
        "SOURCE_CALLS": [],
        "cache_read": forbidden,
        "cache_write": forbidden,
        "read": forbidden,
        "write": lambda path, value: writes.update({str(path): deepcopy(value)}),
        "file_hash": lambda _path: "a" * 64,
        "context": lambda _workers=1: types.SimpleNamespace(
            evaluation=types.SimpleNamespace(
                prepare=forbidden, evaluate=forbidden, evaluate_many=forbidden
            )
        ),
    }.items():
        setattr(common, name, value)
    sys.modules["common"] = common
    for name, attributes in {
        "account_reference": {"verify_account": forbidden},
        "analysis_reference": {"annual": forbidden},

        return {"status": "NOT_APPLICABLE", "reason": analysis["reason"], "comparisons": {}}
    assert analysis["status"] == "PASS" and set(analysis["points"]) == {

        "B0-COUPLED",

    }
    assert set(analysis["summaries"]) == {"B0-TIME", "B0-COUPLED", "N0"}
    assert analysis["summaries"]["N0"]["center_qualified"]
    comparisons = {
        "N0": contrast(
            analysis,
            "B0-TIME",
            "N0",
            "RAW BELOW bear-BODY recovery plus bull-boundary-BODY local ACF eligibility recovery OR exception versus original RAW eligibility; identical13 numeric coordinates, original raw statistic/confirmation/bull/holding/H unchanged; originalACFpass entries have no BODY/bullboundary veto, range/momentum/score still required; full-account propagated effect, not deletion of old trade PnL",
        ),
        "N0-vs-B0-COUPLED": contrast(
            analysis,
            "B0-COUPLED",
            "N0",
            "New RAW local ACF recovery OR eligibility versus old MEAN BELOW CLOSE AND direction reentry; old centered ACF and current CLOSE-up veto differ from new rawACFpass OR selected bear-BODY recovery plus bull-boundary-BODY recovery. Same numeric coordinates; multi-structure historical contrast, not isolated direction-gate evidence",
        ),

            analysis,
            "B0-TIME",
            "B0-COUPLED",
            "Exact old native controls, no new evaluation; existing coupled versus original contrast",
        ),
    }

    old = sorted(analysis["points"][reference], key=lambda row: row["point_index"])

                "closed_difference": second["closed_trades"] - first["closed_trades"],
                "original_qualified": first["qualified"],
                "new_qualified": second["qualified"],
            }
        )
    first, second = analysis["summaries"][reference], analysis["summaries"][label]
    result = {
        "control": reference,
        "new_center": label,
        "purpose": purpose,
        "control_role": first["role"],

        "cagr_same_points": sum(row["cagr_difference"] == 0 for row in rows),
        "drawdown_better_points": sum(row["drawdown_difference"] < 0 for row in rows),
        "drawdown_worse_points": sum(row["drawdown_difference"] > 0 for row in rows),
        "drawdown_same_points": sum(row["drawdown_difference"] == 0 for row in rows),
        "mean_cagr_difference": mean(row["cagr_difference"] for row in rows),

        "q10_cagr_difference": second["q10_cagr"] - first["q10_cagr"],
        "q90_drawdown_difference": second["q90_drawdown"] - first["q90_drawdown"],
        "return_degradation_difference": second["return_degradation"] - first["return_degradation"],
        "drawdown_degradation_difference": second["drawdown_degradation"]
        - first["drawdown_degradation"],
    }
    return result

def economic(bound, result):
    run = result.runs[0]
    own, benchmark = run.execution.account_daily, run.buyhold.account_daily
    years, byears = annual(own), annual(benchmark)
    cagr = float((own.equity.iloc[-1] / 1_000_000) ** (252 / len(own)) - 1)
    bcagr = float((benchmark.equity.iloc[-1] / 1_000_000) ** (252 / len(benchmark)) - 1)
    wealth = np.r_[1_000_000, own.equity.to_numpy()]
    drawdown = float(np.max(1 - wealth / np.maximum.accumulate(wealth)))
    closed = int(run.execution.trades.status.eq("CLOSED").sum())
    negative = [year for year in byears if byears[year]["return"] < 0]
    gates = {
        "return": cagr >= 1.5 * bcagr if bcagr > 0 else cagr > 0,
        "annual_drawdown": all(years[y]["drawdown"] < byears[y]["drawdown"] for y in years),
        "frequency": closed * 60 / len(own) >= 4,
        "negative_buyhold_year_profit": all(years[y]["return"] > 0 for y in negative),
    }
    audit = verify_account(bound, result)
    return {
        "net_cagr": cagr,
        "drawdown": drawdown,
        "closed_trades": closed,
        "frequency60": closed * 60 / len(own),
        "annual": years,
        "benchmark_annual": byears,
        "gates": gates,
        "qualified": all(gates.values()),
        "account_audit": audit,
    }

        )

        return resolve_center(parent, origin, seen)
    return cache_read(
        ROOT / ".tmp" / ("s013-mechanism-" + experiment_id[:5]) / (config["label"] + ".pkl.gz")
    )


def point_cache(control_key, native_label):
    assert control_key in (*CONTROLS, "N0")
    assert (
        native_label.startswith(("B0-TIME-P", "N0-P"))
        and "/" not in native_label
        and "\\" not in native_label
    )
    return TRANSPORT / control_key / (native_label + ".pkl.gz")


def select_new_centers(experiment, analysis):
    assert [row["label"] for row in experiment["controls"]] == list(CONTROLS)
    assert [row["label"] for row in experiment["configurations"]] == ["N0"]
    config = experiment["configurations"][0]
    assert config["mechanism"] == MECHANISM and config["parent_control"] == "B0-TIME"
    return [config] if analysis["rows"]["N0"]["qualified"] else []


def authenticate_center(ctx, config, reference, bound, result):
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(reference)
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
    validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
    assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
    assert (
        plain(bound.strategy.payload) == config["payload"]
        and bound.strategy.candidate_id == config["candidate_id"]
    )
    identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
    assert identity.content_sha256 == config["content_sha256"]
    assert identity.source_sha256 == config["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
    assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
    return ref, identity

def reuse_parameter_control(ctx, key, config, center_reference, design):
    origin, native_label, matrix_name = (
        ("EX015_20261011", "B0-TIME", "parameter_matrix.json")
        if key == "B0-TIME"
        else ("EX043_20261011", "N0", "parameter_matrix_v3.json")
    )
    base = ROOT / "research/S013"
    previous = read(base / "experiments" / origin / "protocols/parameter_plans.json")
    record = next(row for row in previous["centers"] if row["label"] == native_label)
    cache = ROOT / ".tmp" / ("s013-mechanism-" + origin[:5]) / "parameters"
    transport = next(
        row for row in cache_read(cache / "prepared.pkl.gz") if row["label"] == native_label
    )
    old_design = transport["plan"].design
    assert old_design.center == design.center and old_design.protocol == design.protocol
    assert (
        old_design.space.coordinates == design.space.coordinates
        and old_design.points == design.points
    )
    assert record["center_reference"] == center_reference
    matrix = read(base / "assets/runs" / origin / matrix_name)
    assert matrix["status"] == "COMPLETE"
    native_rows = sorted(
        (row for row in matrix["rows"] if row["center"] == native_label),
        key=lambda row: row["point_index"],
    )
    assert [row["point_index"] for row in native_rows] == list(range(32))
    rows = []
    for row in native_rows:
        bound, result = cache_read(cache / (row["label"] + ".pkl.gz"))
        ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(row["reference"])
        assert file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
        formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
        validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
        assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
        assert (
            bound.strategy.candidate_id == row["candidate_id"]
            and result.request_hash == row["request_hash"]
        )
        assert (
            result.result_hash == row["result_hash"]
            and bound.dependencies == transport["center"].dependencies
        )
        binding = bound.lineage.parameter_binding
        assert binding.point == old_design.bind_point(row["point_index"])
        assert binding.plan.to_dict() == record["plan_reference"]
        assert file_hash(binding.plan.resolve(ROOT)) == binding.plan.sha256
        assert read(binding.plan.resolve(ROOT)) == transport["plan"].to_dict()
        identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
        assert identity.content_sha256 == row["content_sha256"]
        assert identity.source_sha256 == config["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
        assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
        assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
        cache_write(point_cache(key, row["label"]), (bound, result))
        rows.append(
            {
                **deepcopy(row),
                "control_key": key,
                "reused": True,
                "reused_from": origin,
                "actual_this_experiment": False,
            }
        )
    return (
        {
            **deepcopy(record),
            "control_key": key,
            "native_label": native_label,
            "reused": True,
            "reused_from": origin,
            "center_qualified": True,
            "role": "exact native "
            + key
            + " full32 control; original IDs/labels/plans/lineage preserved",
        },
        {**transport, "control_key": key},
        rows,
    )

def precheck():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return
    assert not (RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json").exists()
    rows, actual = [], 0
    for record, transport in zip(
        manifest["centers"], cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz"), strict=True
    ):
        key = record["control_key"]
        assert key == transport["control_key"]
        if record["reused"]:
            proof = read(
                ROOT
                / "research/S013/assets/runs"
                / record["reused_from"]
                / "parameter_precheck.json"
            )
            ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(proof["reference"])
            assert proof["status"] == "PASS" and file_hash(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
            assert read(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == {
                name: value for name, value in proof.items() if name != "reference"
            }
            native = next(row for row in proof["rows"] if row["center"] == record["native_label"])
            rows.append(
                {
                    **deepcopy(native),
                    "control_key": key,
                    "reused": True,
                    "source_reference": ref.to_dict(),
                }
            )
            continue
        bound = transport["children"][0]
        serial = context(1).evaluation.evaluate(bound)
        cache_write(point_cache(key, "N0-P00"), (bound, serial))
        spawned = context(2).evaluation.evaluate_many((bound,))[0]
        assert spawned.status.value == "SUCCEEDED", spawned.error
        cache_write(TRANSPORT / key / "N0-P00-spawn.pkl.gz", (bound, spawned.result))
        equal_results(serial, spawned.result)
        actual += 2
        rows.append(
            {
                "center": "N0",
                "control_key": key,
                "point": 0,
                "reused": False,
                "result_hash": serial.result_hash,
                "serial_spawn": "EXACT_EQUAL signals and5strategy/benchmarkledgers",
            }
        )
    assert actual == 2 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    proof = {"status": "PASS", "rows": rows, "actual_evaluations": actual, "provider_calls": []}
    proof["reference"] = publish_material(context(1), "parameter-precheck", proof).to_dict()
    write(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json", proof)


def trial_index(global_index, reused_count):
    assert type(global_index) is int and type(reused_count) is int and reused_count == 64
    assert reused_count <= global_index < reused_count + 32
    return global_index - reused_count


def run():
    source_check()
    manifest = read(MANIFEST)
    if manifest["status"] == "NOT_APPLICABLE":
        return
    assert read(RUNS / "parameter_precheck.json")["status"] == "PASS"
    ctx = context(8)
    prepared = cache_read(TRANSPORT / "prepared.pkl.gz")
    record = next(row for row in manifest["centers"] if row["control_key"] == "N0")
    transport = next(row for row in prepared if row["control_key"] == "N0")
    items = list(zip(record["children"], transport["children"], strict=True))
    assert len(items) == 32
    reused_count = len(manifest["reused_rows"])
    assert reused_count == 64
    study_path = TRANSPORT / "study.pkl.gz"
    if study_path.exists():
        study, state = cache_read(study_path), read(CHECKPOINT)
        assert state["status"] != "FAILED" and state["inflight"] is None
        assert (
            len(state["rows"]) >= reused_count
            and state["rows"][:reused_count] == manifest["reused_rows"]
        )
    else:
        optuna.logging.set_verbosity(optuna.logging.WARNING)
        study = optuna.create_study(
            direction="maximize",
            sampler=optuna.samplers.RandomSampler(seed=13),
            study_name="S013-EX058-raw-bull-boundary-body-bear-below-body-acf-recovery-fixed-parameter-diagnostic",
        )
        for i in range(32):
            study.enqueue_trial({"point": i})
        for i in range(32):
            trial = study.ask()
            assert trial.suggest_int("point", 0, 31) == i
        state = {
            "status": "PARTIAL",
            "rows": deepcopy(manifest["reused_rows"]),
            "inflight": None,
            "actual_run_evaluations": 0,
            "planned_business_accounts": 96,
            "provider_calls": [],
        }
        cache_write(study_path, study)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    for offset in range(len(state["rows"]) - reused_count, len(items), 8):
        batch = items[offset : offset + 8]
        pending = [
            (cfg, bound) for cfg, bound in batch if not point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]).exists()
        ]
        state["inflight"] = [cfg["label"] for cfg, _ in pending]
        state["actual_run_evaluations"] += len(pending)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
        outcomes = (
            ctx.evaluation.evaluate_many(tuple(bound for _, bound in pending)) if pending else ()
        )
        failures = []
        for (cfg, bound), outcome in zip(pending, outcomes, strict=True):
            if outcome.status.value == "SUCCEEDED":
                cache_write(point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]), (bound, outcome.result))
            else:
                failures.append(
                    {
                        "label": cfg["label"],
                        "status": outcome.status.value,
                        "error": {"code": outcome.error.code, "message": outcome.error.message},
                    }
                )
        if failures:
            state.update(status="FAILED", failures=failures, inflight=None)
            write(CHECKPOINT, state)
            raise RuntimeError("Parameter failures retained; no automatic retry/replacement")
        requests, loaded = [], []
        for cfg, expected in batch:
            bound, result = cache_read(point_cache("N0", cfg["label"]))
            assert bound.lineage == expected.lineage
            assert result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256 == cfg["content_sha256"]
            loaded.append((cfg, bound, result))
            requests.append(
                EvaluationEvidenceWrite(
                    EXPERIMENT, "parameter-account-" + cfg["label"].lower(), bound, result
                )
            )
        published = publish_evidence_many(ctx, tuple(requests))
        assert all(outcome.status.value == "PUBLISHED" for outcome in published)
        for index, ((cfg, bound, result), outcome) in enumerate(
            zip(loaded, published, strict=True), start=offset
        ):
            global_index = reused_count + index
            study.tell(
                trial_index(global_index, reused_count), float(result.runs[0].observation.net_cagr)
            )
            state["rows"].append(
                {
                    "label": cfg["label"],
                    "center": "N0",
                    "control_key": "N0",
                    "point_index": cfg["point_index"],
                    "candidate_id": cfg["candidate_id"],
                    "content_sha256": cfg["content_sha256"],
                    "status": "SUCCEEDED",
                    "reference": outcome.reference.to_dict(),
                    "request_hash": result.request_hash,
                    "result_hash": result.result_hash,
                    "reused": False,
                }
            )
        assert len(manifest["reused_rows"]) == reused_count
        state.update(
            status="COMPLETE" if len(state["rows"]) == 96 else "PARTIAL",
            inflight=None,
            elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started,
            provider_calls=SOURCE_CALLS,
        )
        cache_write(study_path, study)
        write(CHECKPOINT, state)
        print({"parameter_rows": len(state["rows"]), "status": state["status"]}, flush=True)
    assert (
        state["status"] == "COMPLETE" and state["actual_run_evaluations"] == 31 and not SOURCE_CALLS
    )
    state.update(
        new_parameter_business_accounts=32,
        reused_parameter_accounts=64,
        actual_parameter_evaluations=33,
    )
    state["reference"] = publish_material(ctx, "parameter-complete-matrix", state).to_dict()
    write(CHECKPOINT, state)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
